title: Corn
description: One corn (maize) clump for a 1 m field cell: three green stalks with pale tassels, broad leaves arching out, two yellow cobs. A single mesh node `crop` (materials crop + cob + tassel), instanced by the thousand.
checks: 3/4 tile: three upright green stalks, each with leaves arching out and drooping at the tip
FRONT tile: two yellow cobs stand out against the green, about half way up
FRONT tile: the tallest tassel reaches 1.6 m, the stalks start on the grid line
TOP tile: the leaves spread to fill most of the 1 m cell without leaving it
